GenAiPlugin.description: Whenever a query comes from user which was related to the hamilton fund pledged and paid in the current year this subagent should run

genAiPluginInstructions.description:
Always Pass the ContactId Variable to the Action "Fetch Pledge and Paid Amount". Get back the data and show it the user in a proper strutcured way
Example :
QUERY - What is my Hamilton Fund Pledged ?
Response - The Hamilton Fund Pledged for the Current Year - $930.01 and the Hamilton Fund Paid for the Current Year - $28.92

GenAiPlugin.scope: This subagent should only handle query related to the Hamilton Fund Pledged or Paid. Never answer any other details apart from the data we get back action
